key_idea: Degenerate the pentagon in characteristic two via the substitution A=x^2, C=[x,y], B=y, so that it becomes a relation in the level-two cyclotomic arrangement algebra, and then use a shift symmetry plus a Vandermonde argument to force the leading terms into the free Lie algebra on ad_C^k B, which gives the dimension bound. Holonomy-built depth-one elements then match that bound.
reason: The characteristic-two degeneration is a surprising idea, and the upper-bound-plus-squeeze structure explains why freeness and generation come out together. But the argument runs through a long chain of filtered comparisons, explicit commutator tables, integral deletion operators, regularized transport, and lattice bookkeeping, so the core idea is buried under substantial technical machinery.
recognized: no (a proof of the Drinfeld–Ihara-type conjecture that the Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is free on generators in odd weights ≥3, via a mod-2 dimension squeeze)
